# 10 · The Observatory
Science tempo as identity: per-tech and per-age payoffs, age-lead as a weapon. The
per-age scaler shape is the real identity and is barely used.
Wins by: First Into the Age (every era) · The Deepest Learning · the curtain itself.

**Tech:** this theme IS the tree — Letters · Calendar (I); Mathematics · The Orrery of Bronze · The Examination Hall · Education (III); Physics · Movable Type (IV). All plain; the age-lead mechanics do the theming.

## Æra I
- Tech:
  - Letters — unlocks Library, The Great Ziggurat, Scholarship, Omen Reading
- Orders:
  - The Almanac — +2 science in your capital, and +1 science in every city with a Library.
  - Star-Gazers — +2 science in every city with a mountain hex inside its borders.
- Religion:
  - Star Readers — +3 science in every city beside a mountain.
  - Keeper of the Calendar — Every 20 turns, you are offered a find from a ruin. A ruin pays once for each age you have reached.
- Deeds:
  - First Into the Age (recurring) — The first empire in the world to reach a new age.

## Æra II
- Orders:
  - The Lyceum (a tech pays a turn of culture — the new derived grant)
  - Scholars' Stipend — +2 science in every city of 5 or more population.
- Wonders:
  - The Great Library — +1 science in every city with a Library · on completion, the technology you are researching is finished
- Deeds:
  - The Scholar's Wager — Stand two whole ages ahead of the most backward empire in the world.
  - The Library of the Realm — Hold a library and a university in four cities.
- Projects *(user — a bead paid by a project needs a bead payout shape; projects are the right vehicle)*:
  - Chart the Stars — late-age tech unlock · buildable only in a city with a Library · large cost · pays a science bead · naval and embarked units +1 movement.

## Æra III
- Tech:
  - Education — unlocks University, The House of Wisdom, The Forbidden City
  - The Examination Hall — unlocks Examination Hall, The Examination Hall · +5 percentage points to the bonus your positive happiness pays
- Orders: 
  - The Uncharted Stars *(user)* — +10% science toward technologies no other empire has researched · −1 gold per science building.
  - ▢ (user todo) an Order touching technology masteries — waits on the masteries decision.
  - The New Model *(user)* — researching a technology that unlocks a military unit musters one free copy in your capital.
- Doctrines:
  - The Encyclopaedia — +1 science for each building in a city. Science buildings cost −50% production.
- Wonders:
  - The House of Wisdom (as built) — +50% science in its city · on completion, the research you are working on completes. *(Answer: it IS a wonder — the finish is an Entry XXXIII completion grant: once, for the builder, at the moment it is raised. Superseded by the rework below.)*
  - The House of Wisdom *(user rework, ratified)* — +15% to the bonus positive happiness pays · +2 science. *(read as: the happiness tiers pay 15% more?)*
  - The Forbidden City *(user)* — −5% happiness demanded in every city · +1 science per point of spare authority.
- Deeds:
  - The Deepest Learning — At the close of the age, the empire that completed the most technologies of it.
  - The Encyclopaedia — A race. Needs a university in every city. The first empire to finish banks a great sum of learning.
- Projects *(user)*:
  - The Turning Heavens (heliocentrism) — late-age unlock · only in a city with a University · large cost · pays a great-person draft of scholars only, and a science bead.

## Æra IV
- Tech: 
  - the closing node of Æra IV pays a bead *(user — the curtain-closer finally rewards the closer)*.
  - The Observatory *(user's building, named — the theme's namesake)* — the Æra IV science building: +10% science in its city · +1 science per citizen here.
- Orders: 
  - The Learned Guard *(user)* — while you hold the most technologies in the world: +10 city defence everywhere and +5 combat strength in your own territory (the card shows whether it is live).
  - The Royal Society *(user)* — +30% production toward projects.
- Deeds: ▢ ________ · finishing the chart as the theme's Opus
- Projects *(user)*:
  - The Alchemical Codex — late-age unlock · only in a city with The Observatory · large cost · all units +5 healing while fortified and +3 combat strength · pays a science bead.

## Gaps
Mostly flat adders today; the age-lead mechanics (cost bands punish laggards) do the work
and nothing celebrates them.
